LESSON: BASIC PRAYERS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship
Topic 2.1: Basic Prayers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Basic Prayers. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention the basic prayers performed for (6 lessons)
2. sing basic prayers for spiritual growth
3. appreciate the qualities of Paramatma through basic prayers. 2.2 Places of worship (3 lessons) four faiths.
4. recognize the features outside/inside a place of worship for familiarization. different places of worship to observe the features inside the places of worship like Deities, Bell, Deepak, flowers etc.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention the basic prayers performed for (6 lessons)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention the basic prayers performed for (6 lessons). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. sing basic prayers for spiritual growth
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing basic prayers for spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the qualities of Paramatma through basic prayers. 2.2 Places of worship (3 lessons) four faiths.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the qualities of Paramatma through basic prayers. 2.2 Places of worship (3 lessons) four faiths. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. recognize the features outside/inside a place of worship for familiarization. different places of worship to observe the features inside the places of worship like Deities, Bell, Deepak, flowers etc.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize the features outside/inside a place of worship for familiarization. different places of worship to observe the features inside the places of worship like Deities, Bell, Deepak, flowers etc. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Basic Prayers.
2. Explain Basic Prayers to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Basic Prayers.
4. Show that you can: mention the basic prayers performed for (6 lessons)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Basic Prayers. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Basic Prayers important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention the basic prayers performed for (6 lessons)
2. sing basic prayers for spiritual growth
3. appreciate the qualities of Paramatma through basic prayers. 2.2 Places of worship (3 lessons) four faiths.
4. recognize the features outside/inside a place of worship for familiarization. different places of worship to observe the features inside the places of worship like Deities, Bell, Deepak, flowers etc.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
